# Class `puc::app::ConfigurationSubsystem`

Own the process-wide Config service from initialize through terminate.

Config performs fresh file reads for every load, so reload operations do not require replacing this object. The stable service and its root policy survive every stop/start cycle; only final termination releases them.

[Source](../../puc-cli/state/configuration.hpp#L34)
